items.title: Derivation of First Equation of Motion (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Derivation of First Equation of Motion: a main subheading of 2.4 Equations of motion, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 28-28.

blocks.text: Farz karein ek body straight line mein uniform acceleration se chal rahi hai aur us ki initial (shuru ki) velocity vi hai. Time t mein us ki velocity vi se badal kar final (aakhri) velocity vf ho jati hai. Acceleration velocity ke change ko time se divide karne se milta hai:
Isay rearrange kar ke (tarteeb badal kar) likhein:
Yeh pehli equation of motion hai. Yeh batati hai ke constant acceleration a se chalti body ki final velocity, initial velocity aur time t se kaise judi hai.
